title: Topics
summary: Records tagged by their own wording as encampment sweeps, belongings disposal, police overtime and budget, or public restrooms, and the findings about them.

paragraphs: Open Topics on the San Diego view. Each topic is a fixed list of word phrases, shown under the topic. A document is tagged when its file name or stored text contains one of them; a request is tagged by its own title or description. A tag is the record's wording, not a finding, and a request is not tagged because one of its documents is.

sections.heading: Findings
items: A finding appears under a topic only when its subject is a tagged record: the document, when the finding names one, otherwise the request, in the same source. Findings about an agency, an entity, or a record merely cited are not listed.
Each finding shows its basis: Counted violation, Stated in the record, or Pattern signal, not a legal claim. Confidence appears only when it was measured.
Very long documents are read to their opening only, and documents without stored text by file name only. The scan summary says how many.

sections.heading: Export
items: Export topic briefing writes a Markdown outline of the topic's findings with basis and citation locators. Quoted text is left out of that file.
The verifiable report exports the topic's 200 highest-ranked findings as a signed HTML file, with checked and masked quotes.
